brief: Anthropic reported Q3 revenue of $16.8bn, up 46% from $11.5bn in Q2, with adjusted profitability and positive cash flow for a second straight quarter, yet its Binance perpetual trades 14% below its all-time high ahead of a ~$2tn November IPO. Annualizing Q3 gives about $67bn, barely above the $65bn run rate reported at end-July. Monthly run-rate growth fell from about 33% (Jan-Jul) to 3.4-6.6% (Aug-Sep), so reaching $100bn by year-end now needs 10.6-12.6% monthly growth in Q4, roughly double the recent pace, against a current-trend path near $89bn. The Ornn token price index hit an all-time low, half its level a month earlier, while Ramp data show token volume still climbing but total spend flat to down since late July, implying usage growth is not converting into revenue. Competition has hardened: OpenAI is competitive again, and Google and SpaceX/xAI are now visible in corporate AI spend, while Meta and Microsoft are shifting workloads in-house. The "adjusted" profit figure is undefined. Anthropic's confidential prospectus showed a $42bn 2025 net loss, $34bn of it a financing accounting charge, plus $518bn of mostly non-cancelable compute commitments. A hotter-than-expected CPI print also widened AI-infrastructure credit spreads at Oracle and CoreWeave, tightening the funding backdrop.
